title: The Wanderer's Reading Passport — Printable Reading Journal
description:
A reading journal disguised as a passport. Every book you finish is a journey: log it on a boarding pass, declare it at customs, and stamp a visa when it earns one.

What's inside (40 pages, PDF):
• Passport cover, holder's data page and reading regulations
• Travel log for the whole year and a world atlas to colour in the countries your books took you to
• 48 numbered boarding passes — title, author, departure and arrival dates, seat, rating
• Customs declarations for your favourite quotes and DNF books
• 6 visa pages plus 2 sheets of 24 printable visa stamps (genres, milestones, "DNF — deported")

Formats included: saddle-stitch booklet for A4 and US Letter (print double-sided, fold, staple — it becomes an A6/pocket passport), single pages in A6 and A5 for binders and tablets, and a one-page print guide.

Instant download: you get the link by email right after checkout. Digital product — nothing is shipped. English edition; a Spanish edition is available in the same listing.

title: Color the Classics — Literary Coloring Book (Printable PDF)
description:
27 classic illustrations to color, each taken from a first or early edition of the story and cleaned by hand into clear, colorable lines: W. W. Denslow's Wizard of Oz (1900), John Tenniel's Alice in Wonderland and Through the Looking-Glass, Hugh Thomson's Pride and Prejudice (1894) and H. J. Ford's fairy tales from the Blue Fairy Book.

What's inside:
• 27 full-page illustrations, each with the line from the book it illustrates
• The Cowardly Lion, the Tin Woodman, the Cheshire Cat, the Mad Hatter, the Jabberwock, Humpty Dumpty, Elizabeth and Darcy, Cinderella, Puss in Boots and more
• "This book belongs to", a color-test page and a bonus page: our own reader, The Books Wanderer, ready to color

Printable PDF, US Letter (8.5 × 11 in), 32 pages — print only the pages you want, as many times as you like; it also fits A4. Instant download: you get the link by email right after checkout. Digital product — nothing is shipped. English edition; a Spanish edition is available in the same listing. Want it bound? See the printed paperback.
